name: Rakuen no Shoutaijou
source:
Hero is chosen by the gods as a humanity representative and thrown to another world with the only farewell words of "Have fun!"

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/05/vn-of-year-1990.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公被众神选为人类代表，扔进另一个世界。临别时，对方只留下一句话：“玩得开心！”

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/05/vn-of-year-1990.html]vndbreview[/url]]
